decisions.reason: The accepted optional tip presets and custom-tip control do not change the fixed $15 mint price or any established revenue-allocation rule.
The tipping UI decision does not change the Transak provider, fiat-to-USDC conversion flow, or supported fiat payment methods.
The source accepts controls on the minting page but does not require corresponding FAQ copy or modify any existing FAQ statement.
Optional tip amounts do not affect how referral codes are derived, displayed, shared, or transferred.
The mint-page tipping options do not change the flat $10 secondary-sale royalty or its enforcement.
The tipping decision does not change allocation of the $5 commission when a mint has no referral code.
Optional buyer tips do not alter the referral commission amount, trigger, recipient, payout destination, or timing.
The source does not state that tips fund, trigger, or otherwise modify the Big Block prize mechanism.
The accepted mint-page tip controls do not require any change to the specified NFT metadata attributes.
The tipping UI decision does not change which NFT-associated entitlements or state transfer on resale.
The source does not state that tips fund, trigger, or otherwise modify the Small Block prize mechanism.
Adding optional tip controls to the minting page does not change the collection's unlimited-mint NFT ebook model.
